notes: Corrected: *due* in *the glory due unto his name* was folded into the rectum as part of the recast construct relation; under rule 20's nominal-recasting boundary (`חֲמַס אֶרֶץ` → *violence done to the land*, *done* added) a construct relation licenses only the preposition, so *unto* stays on `שֵׁם` and *due* is its own added unit.
